data.name: CropLabel
data.comment: The label of the switch that turns crop and pan on: the video shows part of the frame, enlarged, and moves from a start framing to an end framing (the Ken Burns effect). Also the switch's screen reader name. Keep it to about 22 characters.

data.name: CropHint
data.value: Moves from a start framing to an end framing
data.comment: The line under the switch, saying what crop and pan does. No final period, like the line under Deflicker. Keep it to about 44 characters: it wraps to a second line after that.

data.name: ShowName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the three-part switch that picks what the preview shows while crop and pan is on: the video, or the start or end framing to adjust.

data.name: ShowVideo
data.comment: The switch's first part: the preview shows the video as it will be exported, framed. Short: the three parts share 280 px.

data.name: ShowStart
data.comment: The second part: the preview shows the whole frame with the start framing drawn over it, to move and resize. Short.

data.name: ShowEnd
data.comment: The third part: the same for the end framing. Short.

data.name: EditHint
data.value: Drag the frame on the preview to move it, or a corner to zoom
data.comment: The line under the switch while the start or end framing is shown: the framing is a rectangle drawn over the preview. No final period.

data.name: ZoomLabel
data.comment: The label above the slider that sets how much the framing being adjusted enlarges the picture, from 1x to 4x.

data.name: ZoomStartName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the zoom slider while the start framing is adjusted.

data.name: ZoomEndName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the zoom slider while the end framing is adjusted.

data.name: ZoomValue
data.comment: The zoom beside its label: {0} is the number, already in the user's number format with one decimal (1.5). Keep the multiplication sign; French puts a narrow no-break space before it.

data.name: ResetButton
data.comment: The button that gives the framing being adjusted the whole frame again. Short.

data.name: ResetName
data.value: Show the whole frame in this framing
data.comment: The screen reader name of Reset.

data.name: EasingName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the two-part switch that sets how the framing moves from start to end.

data.name: EasingSmooth
data.comment: The first part: the move starts gently, is fastest in the middle and settles into the end framing. Short: the two parts share 280 px.

data.name: EasingLinear
data.comment: The second part: the move keeps one speed from start to end. Short.

data.name: FramingStartName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the start framing drawn over the preview, which the keyboard can move and resize.

data.name: FramingEndName
data.comment: The screen reader name of the end framing drawn over the preview.

data.name: FramingHelp
data.value: The arrow keys move it, Shift with an arrow moves it further, plus and minus zoom
data.comment: The screen reader help of the framing drawn over the preview: the keys that move and resize it.
